column3: Close to the Hebrew; “bear news of his salvation” is rendered “Proclaim the good news of His salvation.”
Close to the Hebrew; אֱלִילִים (“worthless things”) is rendered “idols.”
Close to the Hebrew; the first “splendor” is rendered “Honor,” and the second “beauty.”
Close to the Hebrew; “ascribe” is rendered “Give,” and “clans” “families.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “due,” and “lift up an offering” is rendered “Bring an offering.”
Close to the Hebrew; “adornment of holiness” is rendered “the beauty of holiness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “with uprightness” is rendered “righteously.”
Close to the Hebrew; יִרְעַם (“roar”) is rendered “roar.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV moves “before the LORD” from v13 into this verse, and “forest” is rendered “woods.”
Close to the Hebrew; “faithfulness” is rendered “His truth.”
